name: Time To Dance Academy
description:
Welcome to Time to Dance Academy!
Located in [Vasai West], we specialize in a variety of dance styles, including salsa, bachata, kizomba, jive, Bollywood, hip-hop, Bharatnatyam, and hula hoop. Our experienced instructors provide personalized training for all ages and skill levels, fostering a fun and supportive environment.

Whether you're a beginner or an advanced dancer, our classes focus on technique, creativity, and confidence. We also host performances and workshops to enhance your skills and connect with fellow dancers.

Join us at Time to Dance Academy and let your passion for dance flourish! Visit [https://www.ttda.co.in/] for schedules and enrollment.

owner_posts.post_text: Discover five beginner-friendly dance styles at Time To Dance Academy — each card shows a signature technique, what you’ll learn first, and why our local instructors are trusted. Classes for all ages, with clear beginner/ intermediate breakdowns and nearby studios in Vasai, Virar and Mira Road. Ready to try a class? Call or drop by to book a free trial. 🕺💃🎯

Learn one Salsa move in 30 seconds — right here at our Vasai West studio! 💃🕺 Quick, beginner-friendly micro-lessons filmed on-site make it easy to try the step the same day. See a local student nail it, then book your first class and feel the confidence. Ready to dance in Vasai, Virar or Mira Road? Drop a comment or call to book — we’ll save your spot! 🎉

I love how Jive brings energy to every class — and you can drop in anytime. Perfect for beginners and regulars who want a fun, cardio-packed session without committing to a fixed schedule. 

• 60 or 90 minute sessions
• Drop-in friendly (max 50 participants)
• INR 300 per class

Join me at our nearby studios in Vasai, Virar or Mira Road and feel the beat. Ready to try a class? Book now or check available slots on our page!

name: 567Dance
description:
567Dance specializes in couple dancing. We offer classes such as Salsa, Bachata, Modern Jive, Latin & Ballroom, and Wedding Choreography. In addition to these, we offer styles like Bollywood, Hip hop, and Kathak. Dance classes are taught daily at 567Dance Studio, including group and private dance lessons. Partners are not required. featured_reviews.name: Jolly Correia
featured_reviews.review_text:
What began as wedding dance practices turned into some of the most special moments of my wedding journey, all thanks to Zeenia & Sabby from 567 Dance Studio ✨

We had three dances — a Bollywood mashup, our first dance, and our Bollywood first dance — and every one felt effortless, joyful, and so us. Beyond choreography, they truly showed up as the best of friends — from selecting our entry songs, helping us walk in gracefully, coordinating lights and sound, to ensuring every detail came together perfectly.

What made it even more special is that Zeenia is my childhood best friend, someone I reunited with after almost 20 years — and I honestly can’t put into words the fun, laughter, and comfort we shared during this journey. Practices were filled with late evenings, dancing, snacking, and pure happiness.

When I was at my lowest close to the wedding, they didn’t just teach — they came home, made me smile, made me dance, and lifted my spirit. And while we danced on stage, they stood off stage beaming with pride, cheering us on, like family.

Because of them, our dances became memories filled with love and meaning — and they’ve made me fall back in love with dancing. I truly can’t wait to get back to it and grow with 567 Dance Studio again.

If you’re looking for choreographers who give you more than beautiful dances — who give you heart, friendship, and unforgettable moments — this is it.

Forever Grateful ♥️
— Jolly & Keith.

featured_reviews.review_text: We had an amazing experience preparing for our wedding first dance here! I highly recommend them for any couple looking to make their wedding dance special!

featured_reviews.name: Anupam Ojha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bassein Academy of Performing Arts is an excellent place for learning Kathak in a disciplined, nurturing, and spiritually enriching environment. Classes are conducted at Datta Mandir in Bhaskar Ali, which adds a unique sense of serenity and focus to the learning experience.

Guru Dr. Neeta Surve Deodhar is an exceptional teacher whose dedication to her students is truly inspiring. Along with her impressive academic credentials, she is a highly accomplished Kathak artist who earned her Alankaar degree in 2012. Her commitment to excellence is reflected in the achievements of her students, many of whom have successfully completed Visharad and Alankaar examinations under her guidance.

What stands out most is her personalized attention, patience, and ability to instill both technical proficiency and a genuine love for Kathak. The academy provides a strong foundation for students of all ages and levels.

I would wholeheartedly recommend Bassein Academy of Performing Arts and Guru Dr. Neeta Surve Deodhar to anyone looking for quality Kathak training in a supportive and inspiring atmosphere.
